model_type: Two-Stage Hybrid Edge Pipeline (On-device ML Kit / Apple Vision OCR paired with Quantized 4-bit Local SLM such as Qwen2.5-0.5B or Llama-3.2-1B)
deployment_location: Client on-device (ExecuTorch or ONNX Runtime Mobile on iOS/Android)
privacy_compliance: 100% on-device private processing. Raw images and intermediate tokens remain inside device sandbox; absolute PHI protection without cloud transmission or BAA requirements.
on_device_binary_size_impact: Substantial (550 MB to 1.3 GB). Requires 450 MB-900 MB for 4-bit quantized model weights and 30 MB for the ExecuTorch/ONNX C++ runtime; requires on-demand Wi-Fi asset download rather than bundling in base APK.
printed_label_accuracy: High (90-95% field extraction). Stage 1 captures characters, while Stage 2 SLM repairs minor OCR misspellings and normalizes complex dosing syntax.
handwriting_recognition: Moderate-to-Low (40-52%). Bottlenecked by Stage 1 OCR; while the SLM can infer missing words from partial context, it cannot reconstruct completely unreadable cursive strokes.
multilingual_code_switching_support: Very High. Small modern language models excel at interpreting Tagalog/English code-switched schedule instructions ('tuwing ikawalong oras bago mag-almusal', 'kalahating tableta') into structured interval objects.
curved_surface_and_glare_tolerance: Moderate. Constrained by Stage 1 optical capture; however, linguistic context from the SLM helps resolve truncated words caused by bottle curvature.
tabular_timetable_parsing: High. Combining OCR bounding box coordinates with SLM spatial prompt formatting enables robust tabular timetable reconstruction without column crosstalk.
hallucination_under_degraded_input: Low-to-Moderate. Grammar-based decoding (GBNF / JSON schema masking) prevents structural hallucination, though small SLMs can occasionally invent medication names if OCR output is completely garbled.
latency_seconds: 1.5 to 3.8 seconds on modern mobile chipsets (OCR: ~120 ms; SLM generation at 18-25 tokens/sec: ~1.4 - 3.5 s).
ram_peak_footprint: High (700 MB to 1.4 GB resident memory during SLM generation). Threatens Out-Of-Memory (OOM) termination on low-tier 3GB-4GB RAM caregiver phones.
cost_profile: 100% Free operational cost. Zero cloud API token expenses, zero recurring infrastructure overhead.
react_native_compatibility: Challenging. Requires native C++ JSI bindings to ExecuTorch or ONNX Runtime Mobile. Demands custom Expo development build (EAS) and substantial native maintenance.
offline_readiness: 100% offline. Fully operational without cellular data or internet once local model weights are present on device.
structured_output_support: High. Grammar-guided constrained decoding enforces direct output generation conforming to Alaga's MedicationOcrDraft schema.
formulary_grounding_readiness: High. Output provides cleanly segregated fields that pass directly into local SQLite-based PNDF database for confirmation.
